style: Hand-painted 2D side-view art for a calm, wordless mobile game set on a small Finnish archipelago island in winter. Soft gouache and watercolour texture with subtle paper grain, simple flat layered shapes with gentle internal gradients, no outlines, no hard cel shading, no glossy highlights, no 3D render look. Clear value structure that still reads in greyscale: light snow tops, mid-value bodies, darker bases. Restrained palette: night blue #1C2548, slate #28335E, violet #5B4B8A, silver #B9CAD6, snow #E8EEF5, birch bark #E8E1D2, moss #4A6B3F, spruce #16323A, ice #7FC8E8, sea #2A5C80, wood #7A5638, amber #D98E2B, coral #F49D6E, gold #FFD27A. Quiet, hopeful, uncluttered, generous negative space. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no faces.
isolated: Isolated element on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. Paint it in its natural local colours at middle value under soft even overcast daylight: no cast shadows, no light sources, no glow, no night or sunset tint, muted slightly desaturated colours (never neon or lime), because the game adds darkness, light and colour grading in code. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no sky, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border, no extra buildings, islands or water.
backdrop: Full-bleed portrait painting that fills the entire frame edge to edge, lighting painted in, no frame, no border, no vignette.

workflow.draft: python3 art/generate.py --draft --jobs 6 --prio A   (medium quality into art/raw/draft/)
workflow.final: python3 art/generate.py --jobs 6 --only <accepted names>   (per-asset quality, mostly high, into art/raw/)
workflow.retries: at most one retry per asset
workflow.greyscale_check: every transparent asset must still read when converted to luminance (art.js grey path)

procedural.stars: Procedural for twinkle. No image (generated star fields came back as vignette scenes).
procedural.sun: Procedural. Fix the blown sun: disc fill #FFE8B8 at max alpha 0.85, never white; halo gold #FFD27A then coral #F49D6E, use 'lighter' only for the small halo; cap global exposure at dawn to 1.1; clip the disc under the far_mountains layer so it rises behind the fells.
procedural.lantern_and_window_light: Procedural glows at the unlit lanterns, sauna window and lighthouse lamp in every image. Light is the hero: these are the only bright warm pixels at night.
procedural.night_ending: Code: night sessions end on bg_end_night with exposure <= 0.6 and no white overlay; the current night end brightens to dawn and is blinding.
procedural.colour_return: Assets are painted in local colour at middle value, so desaturation to grey and the bloom to colour show a large, visible change. Order yellow (birches, wood, figure scarf), blue (ice, sea, far layers), green (spruce, moss, aurora), dawn (clouds, shore).
procedural.task_panels_and_breath_orb: Out of scope here: owned by the minigame workflow (task_ prefix).

assets.name: far_mountains
assets.prompt: A long low range of rounded Nordic fells far away, soft silver-blue #B9CAD6 and slate #28335E, pale snow caps, flat bottom edge, occupying only the lower third of the image. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Old one was a thin saturated-blue strip with a baked sun glow; it fought colour grading and did not tile.
assets.use: Tile across the horizon at hy; sat group blue; replaces ridge() far mountains.

assets.name: far_islands
assets.prompt: A chain of low granite skerries and small islands on a flat sea line, each with a few slim spruce silhouettes, slate and spruce colours with pale snow, lower third of the image. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Old islands_distant was glossy and three separate blobs; needs a tileable chain in the new style.
assets.use: Tile just above the sea line; sat group blue; replaces islands().

assets.name: sky_dawn_clouds
assets.prompt: Three or four very thin, flat, long horizontal streaks of stratus cloud stacked loosely across the middle of the image, each streak only 2 to 5 percent of the image height and many times longer than it is tall, like dry-brush strokes dragged sideways, wispy feathered tips. No puffy cumulus lumps, no rounded billows, no single solid cloud bank. Undersides gold #FFD27A and coral #F49D6E, thin soft lilac #9C8AD6 upper edges, the gaps between streaks fully transparent. The streaks run off both the left and right image borders at the same heights and are cut straight by the border, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was one thick puffy cumulus bank (~20% height) that did not reach the right border.
assets.use: Draw only during dawn (alpha = dawn sat), upper 45% of the sky, slow drift; sat group dawn; never under grey. Streaks stop short of the borders (x 48 to 1492), so draw spaced copies, not a seamless tile.

assets.name: sky_aurora
assets.prompt: Only the northern lights, nothing else. A wide, sheer aurora curtain made of many fine, thin vertical light rays of uneven length hanging like a translucent drape, its bottom hem a soft, gently waving S curve running across the full image width, brightest just above the hem, the rays fading upward into black with no top edge and no outline, green #5FE3A1 at the hem fading to teal #4FC3D9 and faint violet #9C8AD6 at the tips. Dim, delicate and see-through, never a solid ribbon, tube or blob, no halo. Upper 55 percent of the image only; the lower part is pure black.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was an opaque tube ribbon with a hard outline. Prio B: if this is not clearly better, keep the procedural aurora.
assets.use: Opaque on black: draw with globalCompositeOperation lighter (black adds nothing) at 0.35 x aurora alpha over the procedural curtain, upper sky; sat group green. Prio B: drop and keep procedural if it does not read.

assets.name: mid_hills_spruce
assets.prompt: Gently rolling snowy hills covered with a dense band of dark spruce silhouettes #16323A of varied heights, snow #E8EEF5 between the trees, lower half of the image. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Mid band is a flat grey ridge with tiny tree pips; this gives depth between far islands and the path.
assets.use: Tile behind the ground at about gy - 0.12H; sat group green.

assets.name: mid_birch_grove
assets.prompt: A loose, irregular row of seven slender Finnish birches spread across the full image width with uneven gaps: two trunks close together, one leaning slightly, one much shorter, heights varying at random, never arranged tallest in the middle and never symmetric. White bark #E8E1D2 with dark horizontal lenticel marks, fine bare twig crowns, a few small golden leaves still attached to the twig tips (no loose floating leaves). Every trunk ends on the same flat base line near the bottom edge with a little snow at its foot.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was a symmetric pyramid (clip art), leaves floated loose like stickers.
assets.use: Forest chunk, behind the figure, bottoms on gy; sat group yellow.

assets.name: birch_cluster
assets.prompt: A cluster of three birches, one leaning, white bark #E8E1D2 with dark marks, fine bare branches, a small mound of snow at the base, full image height.
assets.why: Single accent cluster for sauna and shore chunks; old one was night-tinted.
assets.use: Accent prop in sauna and shore chunks; sat group yellow.

assets.name: sauna_hut
assets.prompt: A small traditional Finnish log sauna hut, warm brown logs #7A5638, thick snow on the roof, short stone chimney, one small square window that is dark and unlit, a tiny porch with a bench and a stack of firewood, standing on a little snow mound.
assets.why: Already wired in world.js; old one was glossy night-blue, so it stayed blue even at dawn.
assets.use: Drop-in for existing sauna_hut draw; window glow stays procedural (stove), placed over the dark window; sat group yellow.

assets.name: lighthouse
assets.prompt: A slender white Nordic lighthouse with one coral-red band #F49D6E, a black lantern room whose glass is dark and unlit, a small iron balcony, standing on a pile of rounded pink-grey granite rocks with snow, full image height.
assets.why: The goal on the horizon (Journey principle). Old one sat on a green blob island and the lamp was not controllable.
assets.use: Far: small at horizon right edge (replaces the striped pip). Near: shore chunk. Lamp glow and beam stay procedural; sat group yellow.

assets.name: pier_boat
assets.prompt: Strict side elevation at eye level, like an architectural side view: no top-down angle, no three-quarter view, deck surface not visible from above. A short weathered grey-brown wooden pier on round posts, the plank edge seen as a thin horizontal band with a little snow along its top, a coil of rope on it, and a small wooden rowing boat in exact profile moored at its right end, hull planks wood #7A5638 with a faded coral #F49D6E stripe along the gunwale. The pier posts and the bottom of the boat hull all end on one straight horizontal line; no water drawn.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was three-quarter top-down, semi-3D and toy-like with a loud orange interior.
assets.use: Drop-in for existing pier_boat draw in the harbour chunk; sat group yellow.

assets.name: boathouse
assets.prompt: A small Finnish red boathouse with a gabled snowy roof standing at the water edge on granite, walls a muted coral #F49D6E deepened toward wood #7A5638, white trim, wide dark doors facing the water.
assets.why: Strongest single colour-return moment in the harbour: grey at night, red at dawn.
assets.use: Harbour chunk background prop; sat group yellow.

assets.name: lantern_post
assets.prompt: A slender weathered wooden post, about eight times taller than it is wide, seen exactly from the side, with a simple thin iron bracket at the top and a small iron hand lantern hanging from it, lantern glass dark and unlit, a small flat irregular cap of snow on top of the post. Painted like a children's picture book illustration in flat gouache: the post is one flat muted grey-brown shape with a slightly darker shadow side band and a few loose dry-brush strokes, the iron in two flat dark tones, soft paper grain. No 3D render, no specular highlights, no plastic or clay look, no fine wood-grain lines, no realism.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 looked like a CGI render (plastic, stubby, photographic grain).
assets.use: Every ~600 world px along the path; procedural glow at the lantern; sat group yellow. Redo 1 dropped (still render-like after one retry): keep the procedural version.

assets.name: ground_sauna
assets.prompt: A horizontal ground strip seen from the side: packed snow path with a few wooden duckboards, a low snowbank and two small rounded stones. Flat walkable top edge at about the middle of the image. Below the top edge the body is a simple soft gradient of shadowed snow and slate #28335E down to the bottom border: no cutaway, no cross-section, no roots or stones shown underground, no hard band at the bottom. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Sauna chunk ground is plain grey. Old strips ended in rounded blobs and were night-tinted.
assets.use: Ground of the sauna chunk, top edge on gy, stretched per chunk with 10% alpha crossfade at chunk borders (extend art.js feather to names starting with ground_); sat group by biome.

assets.name: ground_forest
assets.prompt: A horizontal ground strip seen from the side: snowy forest floor with a few soft patches of muted moss #4A6B3F, fallen birch twigs and small half-buried stones. Flat walkable top edge at about the middle of the image. Below the top edge the body is a simple soft gradient of shadowed snow and slate #28335E down to the bottom border: no cutaway, no cross-section, no roots or stones shown underground, no hard band at the bottom. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.

assets.use: Ground of the forest chunk, top edge on gy, stretched per chunk with 10% alpha crossfade at chunk borders (extend art.js feather to names starting with ground_); sat group by biome.

assets.name: ground_lake
assets.prompt: Only a flat strip of ground. Nothing standing on it: no buildings, no houses, no trees, no piers, no boats, no islands, no people, no props. A horizontal ground strip seen from the side: smooth frozen lake ice #7FC8E8 with faint pale cracks and wind-swept snow streaks on its flat surface, a thin snowy lip at the top edge. Flat walkable top edge at about the middle of the image. Below the top edge the body is a simple soft gradient of shadowed ice and slate #28335E down to the bottom border. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.

assets.prompt: A horizontal ground strip seen from the side: smooth wide pink-grey granite slabs worn by the sea, thin snow in the cracks, a dark wet edge. Flat walkable top edge at about the middle of the image. Below the top edge the body is a simple soft gradient of shadowed snow and slate #28335E down to the bottom border: no cutaway, no cross-section, no roots or stones shown underground, no hard band at the bottom. assets.name: fg_reeds
assets.prompt: Only reeds and grass, nothing else: no buildings, no island, no water, no trees, no lighthouse, no snow ground. A continuous dense row of tall dry reed stalks and grass blades rising from the bottom border, dark near-black blue #0D1326 with a hint of slate, soft edges, filling only the bottom third. The reeds touch the bottom border and run off both the left and right image borders, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Foreground is a few procedural spikes; a dark painted silhouette frames the shot and adds depth.
assets.use: Bottom edge, blurred 2px, light 0.6; sat group green.

assets.name: fg_rocks
assets.prompt: A low irregular cluster of three or four dark granite boulders of different sizes sitting on one flat bottom line, angular and weathered with flat facets and cracks (not round, not pillow or loaf shapes, not symmetric), near-black slate #131B36 with slightly lighter slate #28335E planes, thin uneven snow lying only on the top ledges. Painted in flat gouache shapes, matte, no glossy highlights.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was two symmetric glossy loaf shapes (bread rolls, not granite).
assets.use: Bottom corners, alternating with fg_reeds; sat group blue.

assets.name: fg_branch
assets.prompt: A dark spruce bough hanging down into the frame from the top left corner, near-black spruce #0D1326, soft edges, the rest of the image empty.
assets.why: Top framing element for forest and sauna chunks.
assets.use: Top-left corner in forest and sauna, slow sway; sat group green.

assets.name: figure_walk
assets.prompt: A small slender hooded wanderer seen exactly from the side walking to the right, ankle-length cloak in deep violet #2A2350, a coral #F49D6E scarf trailing behind, no face visible (only soft shadow inside the hood), holding a short pole forward with a small iron lantern hanging from its tip, lantern glass dark and unlit. Simple elegant silhouette, roughly 1:3 width to height.
assets.why: Old figure was a chunky cute mascot with a lit lantern; lantern light must come from code to stay the hero.
assets.use: Replaces procedural figure body at fx; code keeps walk bob and adds lantern glow at the lantern tip (lantern at upper right of the sprite); sat group yellow for the scarf.

assets.name: figure_stand
assets.prompt: Only the single character, nothing else: no ground, no props. A small slender hooded wanderer standing still, full body, seen exactly from the side facing right, centred, about 60 percent of the image height. Ankle-length soft wool cloak in deep violet #2A2350 with a pointed hood that hides the head (no face, only soft shadow inside the hood), a coral #F49D6E scarf wrapped at the neck with one short end hanging down the back, only small dark boot tips under the hem. One hand comes out of the cloak at chest height in front and holds a short wooden pole pointing forward and slightly up to the right, with a small black iron lantern hanging from its tip, lantern glass dark and unlit. Hand-painted gouache with visible soft brush texture, matte. No 3D render, no plastic or clay look.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was a clay/plastic render, pole shouldered diagonally, did not match figure_walk.
assets.use: Shown when not walking; sat group yellow.

assets.name: figure_sit
assets.prompt: The same small slender hooded wanderer sitting on a low wooden bench seen from the side facing right, deep violet #2A2350 cloak, coral #F49D6E scarf, no face, hands in lap, the small dark unlit lantern standing on the bench beside it.
assets.why: Sauna rest and end screen pose; old one was chunky.
assets.use: Sauna chunk rest and end screen; sat group yellow.

assets.name: glow_stone
assets.prompt: A single small river pebble, about half the image width, seen from the side and slightly above, a gently irregular pebble shape with a flat underside, one end a little narrower than the other. Milky, slightly translucent pale stone like frosted quartz or sea glass: cool grey-white #E8EEF5 at the rim, warming smoothly and evenly through soft peach toward a gentle amber #D98E2B warmth that fills the lower middle, as if a faint ember sleeps inside; the warm part has soft diffuse edges and covers about half of the stone, never a spot or stain. Faint fine mineral speckles. Matte, painted in soft gouache with paper grain. No glossy highlight, no cast shadow.
assets.why: Redo 1: v1 was a featureless white ellipse with a dirty yellow stain (soap or egg).
assets.use: Patient view and deck; code adds the pulse glow. Redo 1 dropped (still render-like after one retry): keep the procedural version.

assets.name: bg_start
assets.prompt: Polar night over a small Finnish archipelago: deep night blue sky #070A14 to #1C2548, sparse soft stars, a faint green aurora veil high up, calm dark sea, low snowy islands with spruces on the horizon at 62% height, a tiny distant lighthouse on the right with one small warm light, a single tiny warm window far away. The bottom 25% is dark calm snow and shore, quiet and empty for buttons. Hopeful, not bleak.
assets.why: Start screen is the procedural scene behind buttons; a painted key art sets the quality bar in the first second.
assets.use: Start overlay background, cover-fit; fades into the live world on Begin.

assets.name: bg_end_dawn
assets.prompt: The same small Finnish archipelago at dawn: sky from soft lilac-blue #9FC3E0 at the top through peach #F7C59F to gold #FFD27A at the horizon, the sun just below the horizon so there is no white disc, warm light on thin clouds, calm sea reflecting gold and coral streaks, islands with spruces in soft violet-blue, a white lighthouse with a coral band on the right catching the first light. The brightest value is soft gold #FFE8B8, never pure white. Saturated, warm, hopeful.
assets.why: Dawn is washed grey-beige with a blown white sun; this is the reward image and the colour target for the code dawn.
assets.use: End screen behind 'Good morning.'; also the colour reference for the procedural dawn grade.

assets.name: bg_end_night
assets.prompt: The same small Finnish archipelago late at night, very calm and dim: indigo sky #0D1326 to #1C2548, a thin crescent moon behind veiled cloud, a few stars, dark still sea with a faint silver moon path, low islands in silhouette, one tiny warm sauna window glowing softly far away on the left. Low brightness overall, no bright areas, sleepy.
assets.why: The night ending is blinding; a bedtime session must end dim.
assets.use: End screen for night sessions ('Rest well.').

assets.name: bg_patient
assets.prompt: Early morning over the same archipelago, soft and low contrast: pale blue-grey sky #9FC3E0 fading to faint peach at the horizon at 60% height, calm sea, low islands with spruces, the lighthouse small on the right, a darker quiet upper third for text overlay.
assets.why: Patient view currently renders the live game behind text; a calm painted backdrop reads as a finished app.
assets.use: Patient view background, cover-fit, dark scrim on top for text.

assets.name: app_icon
assets.prompt: App icon: a single small white lighthouse with a coral band on a dark rounded island, centred, under a soft green aurora arc on a deep night blue #0D1326 background, one warm amber light in the lantern room. Very simple bold shapes readable at 60 px, no small detail, full-bleed square with no rounded corners and no border.
assets.why: Old icon came out on a white background and too detailed.
assets.use: iOS and Android app icon, PWA icon.

assets.name: fog_band
assets.why: Already deployed in demo/assets and reads well; feathered by art.js.
assets.use: Unchanged.

assets.name: fog_band_b
assets.why: Already deployed; second fog copy.

suffixes.sky: Isolated sky element on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. It carries its own light and colour exactly as described (warm-lit or luminous as named), soft and painterly, never neon. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no land, no water, no trees, no horizon, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border.
suffixes.additive: Flat pure black #000000 background filling the whole frame, for additive blending in code: every pixel that is not part of the light itself is exactly black. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no land, no water, no trees, no horizon, no stars, no frame, no vignette, no border.
